extracted.name: Chicago-Style Pan Pizza
extracted.description: This is the best Chicago pan-style pizza that is also easy to make. Layer dough with sausage, cheese, and tomato sauce, or customize to your liking.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1 pound) loaf frozen bread dough, thawed
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Press dough into the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9x13-inch baking dish.

Crumble sausage into a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook and stir until evenly browned. Remove sausage with a slotted spoon and sprinkle over the dough crust. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese evenly over sausage.

Add mushrooms and onion to the skillet; cook and stir until onion is tender. Stir in tomatoes, oregano, salt, fennel seed, and garlic powder. Spoon over mozzarella cheese. Sprinkle Parmesan cheese over the top.
Bake in the preheated oven until crust is golden brown, 25 to 35 minutes.
